summary: Check Point Software Technologies Ltd., a foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K reporting results of its Annual General Meeting held September 2, 2026. Shareholders, representing approximately 81.2 million ordinary shares (79.52% of outstanding), voted on five routine proposals: election of seven directors and approval of independent accountants and executive compensation. All proposals passed with requisite majorities under Israeli law. The filing is a routine meeting outcome notice, not a special situation. No transaction terms, deal structure, or strategic actions are disclosed. The event is purely administrative; there is nothing to watch or arbitrage.
